blocks.text: Your schema lives in three places.
Only one of them is right. Nobody knows which.

scenes.caption: @forinda/kickjs-db puts it in one place. You write your tables in TypeScript, once.
scenes.spoken: KickJS D-B puts it in one place. You write your tables in TypeScript, once.

scenes.caption: Change the schema and run kick db generate. You get the SQL to apply, a draft to undo it, and a snapshot of what the database should look like.
scenes.spoken: Change the schema, and run kick D-B generate. You get the SQL to apply, a draft to undo it, and a snapshot of what the database should look like.

blocks.label: up.sql

scenes.caption: Generated SQL waits for a person. Outside development, the runner refuses any migration nobody has reviewed. Read it, approve it, ship it.
scenes.spoken: Generated SQL waits for a person. Outside development, the runner refuses any migration nobody has reviewed. Read it, approve it, ship it.

scenes.caption: At boot, @forinda/kickjs-db compares the live database with the last snapshot. If someone changed it by hand, you hear about it first. Indexes you add on purpose? Leave them out by name.
